channel.title: Coastal Eventures: upcoming events
channel.description: The next 40 dated events on the Gulf Coast.

item.title: Blackout Bowling at The Gulf Bowl (FRI 10/23)
item.description: Friday 10/23 · 6:00 PM to Saturday 10/24 · 1:00 AM | The Gulf Bowl & Captain's Choice Seafood Bar | from $24. A Halloween bowling package pairs unlimited black-light bowling with two laser tag admissions, a ten dollar arcade card and a costume contest, open to the public. The package runs from Friday evening into the early hours of Saturday.

item.title: Blithe Spirit: Theatre 98 (FRI 10/23)
item.description: Weekends 10/16-11/1/2026 · eves + matinees | Theatre 98, Fairhope | from $20. Noël Coward's classic ghost-comedy plays at Fairhope's intimate community playhouse, a witty, dressed-up date in Fairhope.

item.title: Game Days at Marina Bar & Grill (FRI 10/23)
item.description: Thursday 10/1 | Marina Bar & Grill, Sandestin Golf and Beach Resort | No published price. Marina Bar & Grill at Baytowne Marina runs its own Game Days program, showing NCAA football on Saturdays and NFL games on Sundays plus select Monday and Thursday nights. It sits right on the marina at Sandestin.

item.title: Garden & Gun Society and Friends Gathering at Alys Beach (FRI 10/23)
item.description: Thursday 10/22 to Sunday 10/25 · schedule on the event itinerary | Alys Beach | No published price. Alys Beach hosts the Garden & Gun Society and Friends Gathering from Thursday, October 22 through Sunday, October 25 in partnership with Garden & Gun magazine. The four day event brings together chefs, artisans, designers, musicians, conservationists and storytellers for curated dinners, conversations, architectural tours, outdoor excursions and live music. Tickets and the full itinerary are on the link from Alys Beach's event page.

item.title: Haunted History Walking Tours (FRI 10/23)
item.description: Fri 10/23 and Sat 10/24 · 6:30 PM, 7:30 PM and 8:30 PM | Historic Pensacola Village | from $15. Historic Pensacola runs two after-dark walking tours on four nights in October. The Haunted Village tour visits the Dorr House, Old Christ Church and the Lear/Rocheblave House, and Macabre Museum Mysteries goes through the Arbona Building and the Museum of History. Children 3 and older are welcome.

item.title: Hot In Herre: 2000s Dance Party (FRI 10/23)
item.description: Friday 10/23 · Doors 9:00 PM · Show 9:30 PM | Vinyl Music Hall | from $15. Blisspop's 2000s throwback dance party takes over Vinyl Music Hall for guests 18 and up. Doors open at 9 PM ahead of the 9:30 PM start, and published pricing runs $15 to $22 per ticket.

item.title: Island Fights 100 (FRI 10/23)
item.description: Friday 10/23 · Doors 5:30 PM · First fight 6:30 PM | Pensacola Bay Center | from $26. Island Fights hits its 100th event with a live MMA card at the Bay Center. Doors open an hour ahead of the 6:30 PM first fight, and the fight order is subject to change. Tickets start at $26, an adults' night out rather than a kids' outing.

item.title: Jazz Art Writers South Festival Youth Exhibit (FRI 10/23)
item.description: Tuesday 9/15 | West Regional Library | No published price. West Regional Library hosts this youth exhibition tied to the Jazz Art Writers South Festival, a partnership between Mobile Arts Council and Amp Up Arts. More than 50 paintings by artists ages 8 to 18 line the space, each interpreting jazz through color and line. No viewing hours are published for Tuesday, September 15, so call the library to confirm.

item.title: JD Simo with Luther Dickinson and Black Joe Lewis & The Honeybears at The Merry Widow (FRI 10/23)
item.description: Friday 10/23 · 8:00 PM (doors 7:00 PM) | The Merry Widow | from $32.50. The Merry Widow in downtown Mobile hosts a double headliner on Friday, October 23, with JD Simo and Luther Dickinson sharing the bill with Black Joe Lewis & The Honeybears. Doors open at 7:00 PM and the show starts at 8:00 PM. Presale tickets are $32.50 and day of show tickets are $45 if any remain.

item.title: Mobile Opera: Romeo et Juliette (FRI 10/23)
item.description: Friday 10/23 · 7:30 PM and Sunday 10/25 · 2:30 PM | The Temple Downtown | No published price. Mobile Opera stages Gounod's Romeo et Juliette in French with English supertitles, with a Friday evening show and a Sunday matinee. Mobile County's listing does not publish a ticket price.

item.title: MONOCHROME exhibition (FRI 10/23)
item.description: Sunday 9/27 to Saturday 10/24 · times not posted | Blue Morning Gallery | No published price. Monochrome is a group show by three artists at Blue Morning Gallery, 21 S. Palafox Place in downtown Pensacola, running through Saturday, October 24. The black-and-white work asks what you notice, such as shadow angles, line curves and surface grain. The First Friday reception was October 2 and has passed.

item.title: More Than Revival weekend (FRI 10/23)
item.description: Friday 10/23 · 7:00 PM · Saturday 10/24 · 6:00 PM · Sunday 10/25 · 9:00 AM, 11:00 AM and 6:00 PM | Avalon Middle School (hosted by Voyage Church) | from $15. Voyage Church hosts a three-day revival weekend at Avalon Middle School in Milton, with a Friday night kickoff, Saturday and Sunday services, a ministry expo, food trucks and water baptisms on Sunday. Tickets are needed, and the Voyagers children's program covers ages 3 months through 5th grade at every service. Saturday breakout sessions are at Voyage HQ on Mulat Road, where children cannot attend and childcare is not provided.

item.title: Painting with a Twist Pensacola: paint-and-sip, family paint days and date nights (weekly programme) (FRI 10/23)
item.description: Classes most days: family days Saturday 10:30 AM, brunch Sunday 11 AM, evenings Wednesday to Saturday | Painting with a Twist Pensacola | $35 per family. Painting with a Twist Pensacola is an artist-led paint-and-sip studio at 4771 Bayou Blvd Suite C11 with several classes every week. October has family paint days (ages 6 and up with a parent, no alcohol), adult Paint & Sip and Date Night classes (ages 16 and up on date nights), Halloween-themed canvases and Paint Your Pet. Classes cost $35-$60 depending on the class, and alcohol is sold on site with no BYOB.

item.title: Parrot Heads in Paradise: Meeting of the Minds (FRI 10/23)
item.description: Wednesday 10/21 to Sunday 10/25 · schedule on motm.rocks | The Hangout, LuLu's and Flora-Bama | No published price. Parrot Head clubs from across the country gather in Gulf Shores for five days of live music, themed nights and Cheeseburger in Paradise menu items. The main stage is at The Hangout, with more events at LuLu's and Flora-Bama. Registration is open to non-members.

item.title: Pensacola Beach Yoga: Friday and Wednesday beach classes (FRI 10/23)
item.description: Fridays 9 AM and Wednesdays 6 PM | Pensacola Beach Yoga, beside the Gulf Pier | from $10. Pensacola Beach Yoga runs drop-in yoga on the sand beside the Gulf Pier at 41 Fort Pickens Road in Pensacola Beach. Classes are Fridays at 9 AM and Wednesdays at 6 PM, and they cost $10 with no registration. Bring a mat or towel.

item.title: Pensacola Interstate Fair (FRI 10/23)
item.description: Oct 22 – Nov 1 | Pensacola Interstate Fairgrounds | No published price. Eleven days of rides, livestock barns and fried everything at the fairgrounds off Mobile Highway. The 60% off Super Saver closed on 07/15/2026, and the fair has not posted what replaces it.

item.title: Plantmania Expo 2026 (FRI 10/23)
item.description: Friday 10/23 · 10:00 AM to 5:00 PM · Saturday 10/24 · 10:00 AM to 4:00 PM | Daphne Civic Center | from $15. Plantmania brings a two-day tropical plant expo to the Daphne Civic Center, with live workshops, free classes, plant care and propagation demonstrations and a marketplace of plant vendors and makers. General entry is $15 and children 12 and under get in free. Classes come with entry, while the Kokedama, Terrarium and Staghorn Fern workshops cost extra.

item.title: Primal Fear Haunted Attraction at OWA (FRI 10/23)
item.description: Select nights through October 31 · evenings | OWA Parks & Resort | No published price. OWA's immersive haunted attraction runs on select nights through the end of October, with dates including September 25 to 26 and October 2 to 3, 9 to 10, 16 to 17 and 19 to 31. A $7 Zombie Laser Tag add-on is available alongside the main attraction, and tickets are required.

item.title: Public Ice Skating at the Pensacola Bay Center (FRI 10/23)
item.description: Oct 17 to Oct 30 · one hour sessions, see dates | Pensacola Bay Center | from $15. The Pensacola Bay Center opens its ice for one-hour public skate sessions from October through April. The first sessions in this window run Saturday 10/17 at 9:30 PM, Sunday 10/18 at 1:30, 3:00 and 4:30 PM, Saturday 10/24 at 9:30 PM, Sunday 10/25 at 1:30, 3:00 and 4:30 PM, and Friday 10/30 at 9:30 PM. Capacity is limited for each session, so buy tickets early.

item.title: Pumpkin Decorating Contest at Niceville Library (FRI 10/23)
item.description: Entries through Saturday 10/17 · voting Monday 10/19 to Saturday 10/24 · winners Tuesday 10/27 | Niceville Library | No published price. Niceville Library runs a pumpkin decorating contest for ages 13 and older. Entrants drop off a decorated pumpkin with a completed entry form during library hours through Saturday, October 17, and visitors vote for a favorite from October 19 to 24. The top three pumpkins win prizes announced on October 27, and entrants collect their pumpkins by 2:00 PM on October 31.

item.title: Rocky Homicide Murder Mystery Dinner Theatre (FRI 10/23)
item.description: Fri 10/23 & Sat 10/24/2026 · Doors 6:00 PM · Show 7:00 PM · also 10/29-10/30 | Heritage Hall at Seville Quarter | from $69. This boxing-gym whodunit downtown is the longest run of the series, four nights across two weekends. It includes dinner, a cast working the room, and clues between courses.

item.title: Shinedown's Lunatic Ball Beach Weekend (FRI 10/23)
item.description: Friday 10/23 | Seascape Resort | No published price. Shinedown's Lunatic Ball Beach Weekend brings a multi-day music getaway to Seascape Resort starting Friday, October 23. No start time or address is posted for the weekend yet. The resort's own event page carries them first.

item.title: South Walton Celebrity Golf Classic (FRI 10/23)
item.description: Thu 10/22 · 5:30 PM opening · Fri 10/23 · 8:30 AM to 6:00 PM · Sat 10/24 · 8:00 AM to 4:00 PM | Raven Golf Club / Sandestin Golf and Beach Resort | No published price. The South Walton Celebrity Golf Classic returns to Raven Golf Club at Sandestin Golf and Beach Resort on Thursday, October 22, running from 8:30 AM to 6 PM. The multiday fundraiser supports the Emerald Coast Children's Advocacy Center and combines golf programming with receptions across the event. It repeats annually, and these are its opening days.

item.title: Sweeney Todd: The Demon Barber of Fleet Street (FRI 10/23)
item.description: Fri 10/23 to Sun 11/1 · Fri and Sat 7:30 PM, Sun 2:30 PM | Pensacola State College, Ashmore Auditorium, Building 8 | No published price. Pensacola State College stages Sweeney Todd: The Demon Barber of Fleet Street in Ashmore Auditorium over two weekends, October 23 to 25 and October 30 to November 1. The college describes the eight-time Tony Award winning musical as a thriller about an exiled barber who seeks revenge on a corrupt system of justice. One performance falls on Halloween night.

item.title: Sweet Dreams Haunted Attraction (FRI 10/23)
item.description: Fridays 7:00 PM to 10:00 PM · Saturdays 7:00 PM to 11:00 PM · Sundays 7:00 PM to 9:00 PM through 11/1 | Sweet Dreams Haunted Attraction | from $25. Sweet Dreams Haunted Attraction runs an indoor haunted house at 811 St Francis St in downtown Mobile on Friday, Saturday and Sunday nights through Sunday, November 1. Guests walk through dark mazes with live scare actors, and optional Blackout and Chamber mini escape games cost extra. The attraction warns it may be too intense for younger children, and every child must be accompanied by an adult.

item.title: The 39 Steps: Hitchcock Farce (ECTC) (FRI 10/23)
item.description: Oct 15-25 · Thu-Sat 7 PM · Sun 2 PM · Wed 1 PM · Thu 10/22 also 1 PM | Emerald Coast Theatre Company | No published price. Four actors play 150 roles in a full-tilt Hitchcock spoof that is clean, fast, and laugh-out-loud. It is the safe-bet theatre date of the fall.

item.title: Wanda Sullivan: Bloem Exhibition (FRI 10/23)
item.description: Now through December 11 | Anna Lamar Switzer Center for Visual Arts | No published price. A gallery exhibition by artist Wanda Sullivan runs at Pensacola State College's visual arts center through mid-December. The center's own site does not publish an admission price.

item.title: Wandaween: Jennifer's Body Screening and Costume Contest (FRI 10/23)
item.description: Friday 10/23 · 9:30 PM (doors 9:00 PM) | Crescent Theater | from $14.41. Wanda Doomy hosts Wandaween at the Crescent Theater in Mobile on Friday, October 23, with a screening of Jennifer's Body and a Wanda costume contest. Doors open at 9:00 PM and the show starts at 9:30 PM. The event is 18 and up.

item.title: Orionid Meteor Shower: Halley's Comet dust (FRI 10/23)
item.description: Thu 10/22/2026 · from 3:15 AM, once the moon is down | Your own yard, or Big Lagoon State Park for a darker sky | Free. These are crumbs off Halley's Comet hitting the air at forty-one miles a second. The catch this year is a fat gibbous moon that washes the sky out until it sets at quarter past three, which leaves about two and a half hours of real darkness before dawn on the 22nd.

item.title: The Great Bellingrath Harvest (FRI 10/23)
item.description: Daily through 11/8 · 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM | Bellingrath Gardens and Home | from $11. Bellingrath Gardens and Home runs a fall festival from September 19 through November 8 with seasonal displays across the gardens, including the scarecrow exhibit and pumpkin displays. The gardens are open daily, and the general admission price applies. The events page does not list a separate price for the harvest, so the gardens ticket is the number to plan with.

item.title: Cornhole Open Play (FRI 10/23)
item.description: 8:30 AM to 4:30 PM | Niceville Senior Center | from $5. Members toss bags at the boards during open-play cornhole at the Niceville Senior Center. It runs casually throughout the center's regular weekday hours. City of Niceville residents play free, and everyone else pays a $5 day rate.

item.title: Exercise Room (FRI 10/23)
item.description: 8:30 AM to 4:30 PM | Niceville Senior Center | from $5. The Niceville Senior Center's exercise room stays open for members to work through strength, cardio, and flexibility routines on their own schedule. Equipment includes two recumbent bikes, a treadmill, free weights, a stability ball, mats, and stretch bands. City of Niceville residents get free access, and everyone else pays a $5 day rate.

item.title: Putting Green Open Play (FRI 10/23)
item.description: 8:30 AM to 4:30 PM | Niceville Senior Center | from $5. Members check out putters and balls at the front desk to practice on the Niceville Senior Center's putting green. It is casual, and you can work on your short game alone or play a round with friends. City of Niceville residents get free access, and everyone else pays a $5 day rate.

item.title: Table Tennis Open Play (FRI 10/23)
item.description: 8:30 AM to 4:30 PM | Niceville Senior Center | No published price. Niceville Senior Center's table tennis room is open for casual, drop-in play with no experience required. The city describes it as an active, social way to spend the morning rather than a competitive league. It shares the Tuesday 8:30 AM to 4:30 PM window with several other open-play programs at the center, and members age 55 and up are the intended audience.

item.title: Adventure Zone at Steve's Fishing and Adventure Farm (FRI 10/23)
item.description: Mon-Sat through Oct 31 · 9 AM to 6 PM | Steve's Fishing and Adventure Farm | No published price. Steve's Farm has rebranded as Steve's Fishing and Adventure Farm and opened a fall attraction in Walnut Hill with a corn maze, a giant slide, a kids' zipline, a jump pad, hayrides, a wagon train, a sunflower field and a pumpkin patch. It suits a family with small children who want a half day outdoors. The farm's own page does not print admission prices, so check the ticket page before driving out.

item.title: Fall Into Family History at Santa Rosa County Libraries (FRI 10/23)
item.description: Wednesday 10/7 Pace · Wednesday 10/14 Jay · Wednesday 10/21 Gulf Breeze · Wednesday 10/28 Navarre · 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM | Santa Rosa County libraries: Pace, Jay, Gulf Breeze and Navarre | No published price. The library system's lead reference specialist visits one branch each Wednesday in October to help people start or extend a family tree. Visitors can bring a specific research question or simply stop by to learn how to get started with the library's genealogy resources. The help runs during regular library hours, so no appointment time is listed.

item.title: Jeepalooza Beach Jam 2026 (FRI 10/23)
item.description: Thursday 10/22 · 9:00 AM | Destin / event headquarters area | No published price. Jeepalooza Beach Jam brings a Gulf Coast Jeep gathering to the Destin event headquarters area starting at 9 AM on Thursday, October 22. It runs the Shuckin' Fun Poker Run, a Vendor Village, and a Spookalooza Show N' Shine lineup. A Stock the Jeep food drive runs alongside the show, so bring a canned good. Registration is required for the ride and show events with prices that vary by package, and spectator access to many activities has no published price.

item.title: Ping Pong Meet-Up (FRI 10/23)
item.description: 9:30 AM to 11:00 AM | Niceville Senior Center | No published price. This ping pong meetup at the Niceville Senior Center is open to beginners and experienced players alike, and the city says no experience is required to join in. It runs Wednesday mid morning and repeats on multiple weekdays.

item.title: Coco & Crawlers (FRI 10/23)
item.description: Thursday 9/17 · 10:00 AM to 11:00 AM | Ben May Main Library, Youth Programming Room | No published price. This caregiver meetup in the Youth Programming Room at Ben May Main Library pairs children's play with a warm drink. It gives caregivers time to connect with each other. It runs Thursday morning from 10 AM to 11 AM, repeating on the third Thursday of the month, with more dates on October 15, November 19 and December 17. Registration is requested but not required.

item.title: Destin Fishing Rodeo: Daily Public Weigh-Ins (FRI 10/23)
item.description: Daily, Oct 1 – Oct 31 · 10:00 AM-7:00 PM | Docks behind AJ's Seafood & Oyster Bar | Free. Anglers competing in the month-long Destin Fishing Rodeo bring their catches to the scale on the harbor docks behind AJ's Seafood & Oyster Bar every day in October. The public is welcome to watch for free from 10 AM to 7 PM, and the crowd tends to grow with the size of the fish coming off the boats.
